name: accordion
useFor: Use Accordion for questions and answers (a pricing FAQ, setup help) and for long lists people scan by title. type="single" (the default) keeps one item open; type="multiple" lets several stay open. Use variant="compact" for a changelog or an activity list (the mark first, 14px titles, no rules). Keep answers short; link out for more.
constraints: A caret or chevron in place of the hexagon
Panels that slide sideways or fade in
source: The Hoplite website's pricing FAQ (.faq__item, .faq__icon, .faq__hex, .faq__bar) and changelog entries (.cl-entry, .cl-entry__icon, .cl-entry__body)

Model tokens and sandbox time. Every plan includes some each month, per seat on paid plans. Beyond that, runs draw on prepaid credits you buy in Billing. What happens when I reach a limit? Running threads finish their current step and pause. Add credits or move to a bigger plan and they pick up where they stopped. How many agents run at once? Five concurrent cloud sessions on Free, twenty per seat on Team, and as many as you need on Enterprise. Can I switch plans or cancel? Any time, from Billing. Changes take effect at the next billing date, and unused credits stay on the workspace. ); } export function Multiple() { return ( Which sandbox sizes are there? From 2 vCPU with 8 GiB of memory up to 16 vCPU with 64 GiB, billed by the second. Which models can agents use? Every platform model on every plan. Bring your own subscription to run on your own limits. Does the Platform API cost extra?  Checks rerun when a sandbox restarts

A restarted sandbox now replays the last failing check before the agent continues, so the run never resumes on a stale result.

title: Accordion
description: The pricing FAQ: ruled rows of 18px questions, each with a 20px outlined hexagon holding a plus at the end; open, the hexagon turns 30 degrees, the plus becomes a minus and the 16px light graphite answer opens with its height. A compact variant is the changelog entry.
